exposure: mutation c.391C>T p.Leu131Phe in the AT gene (SERPINC1)
treatment protocols (anticoagulation and/or replacement of AT during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included eight women with homozygous AT deficiency heparin-binding site (HBS), who had experienced at least one pregnancy.
finding: Homozygous AT deficiency HBS, a severe thrombophilia, is associated with a high risk of pregnancy loss and preterm delivery.
